name: G Mukesh
headline: Business Developer @ Indpro
about: Business Development & Digital Transformation Leader at INDPRO AB, with experience spanning technology, strategy, recruitment, operations, marketing, and client growth. My journey combines business development with hands-on exposure to digital transformation, enterprise solutions, and technical delivery. At Accenture, I worked as a Packaged App Developer Associate, strengthening my foundation in coding, project execution, and scalable digital solutions. At INDPRO AB, I focus on building partnerships, driving growth opportunities, and connecting businesses with impactful technology solutions. Beyond tech, my experience includes leading wholesale and retail operations in the textile industry, managing recruitment and onboarding as an HR Recruiter Lead, contributing to talent acquisition at ILP Overseas, driving marketing initiatives with UNDER25, and supporting finance operations and MIS reporting at Ramaiah Evolute. With a background that bridges technology, business strategy, people management, and client relations, I enjoy creating meaningful business impact, building long-term relationships, and helping organisations scale through innovation and execution. Top skillsCommunication • Strategy • Human Resources (HR) • Financial Analysis • Recruiting

recent_activity: G Mukesh • 1st Business Developer @ Indpro 2w • Sometimes I wonder what life would have looked like if I had stayed where I was. Not because I regret moving on, but because it's natural to question the roads we didn't take. Then I think about everything this journey has given me outside of a job title. The people I've met. The conversations that changed my perspective. The friendships that became genuine. The unexpected opportunities that found me when I wasn't even looking. Some of the biggest moments in my personal life happened because I chose a different path. A passion I had quietly carried for years suddenly became something real. Doors I never imagined would open, opened. I met people who saw potential in me before I fully saw it in myself. Maybe every career decision comes with a trade-off. You gain something. You leave something behind. I've stopped asking whether it was the "right" decision. Instead, I'm grateful for the people, experiences, and unexpected chapters that this journey has added to my story. Sometimes the destination isn't what changes your life.
